text:
tina: deploy-bot alerted on post-deploy synthetic failures for the prefill-check in eu3 after the 03:45 rollout. 4/10 probes failed within the first 4m. tagging eng-releases for a quick triage.

deploy-bot: AUTO: postdeploy-synth eu3 prefill-check: 4/10 fails. canary cohort: 5%. rolling forward paused. logs: /deploy/logs/2860012345/eu3.

ops-bot: quick telemetry: p95 jumped from 40ms -> 480ms on the failing window. interestingly, failures align with a nightly cron job that flushes an infra cache at 03:46 UTC (cron id: infra-cleanup/03).

sre-bot: sampler confirms: TTL eviction spikes coincide with cron flush and cause higher KV miss rates for ~90s. only affects eu3 edge due to staggered cache topology.

mike: mitigation suggestion: 1) pause rollout and pin canary to 0% while we assess, 2) delay the infra cron during change window, 3) run targeted prefill warming on eu3 after cron completes, then re-run synths. rollback only if failures continue after warmup.

tina: agree. pausing rollout now and requesting infra to delay the 03:46 job for this change window. deploy-bot: pause please.

deploy-bot: ACTION: rollout paused by tina. canary set to 0%.

ops-bot: infra acknowledged. delaying infra-cleanup/03 for 10m. triggered targeted prefill on eu3 IG: `prefill-trigger --region eu3 --scope canary`.

sre-bot: re-run synthetic (interval 8s, 6 probes) after prefill completes.

(90s)

sre-bot: synthetic results: 6/6 success, p95 59ms. no additional deadman hits.

mike: decision: no rollback. root cause: scheduled infra cache flush overlapping change window and a non-staggered cache eviction pattern in eu3. short-term: delay infra-cleanup during active rollouts. long-term: make cache eviction staggered across zones.

tina: adding release-note snippet: "Post-deploy: transient prefill latency in eu3 due to infra cache eviction cron overlapping change window. Mitigated by delaying cron and targeted prefill; rollout resumed. No customer impact."

deploy-bot: AUTO: postdeploy-synth resolved. canary resumed at 5%.

mike: filing follow-up infra task INFRA-4123 to stagger cache evictions and add a guard to block infra-crons during active rollouts.

tina: closing thread. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
